mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER (SPOTIFY_ID, NICKNAME, EMAIL, PROFILE_IMG_URL, REFRESH_TOKEN, CREATED_AT, LAST_LOGIN_AT) VALUES ( #{spotifyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{nickname, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileImgUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refreshToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET NICKNAME = #{nickname, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EMAIL = #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PROFILE_IMG_URL = #{profileImgUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REFRESH_TOKEN = #{refreshToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_LOGIN_AT = SYSDATE WHERE SPOTIFY_ID = #{spotifyId}
mapper.select: SELECT REFRESH_TOKEN FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
